48.1: Aizaz Khan bangs it in short, and Janith Liyanage launches it majestically over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
48.2: Aizaz Khan searches for yorker length, but Janith Liyanage expertly guides it down to third man for four.
48.3: Aizaz Khan induces the edge, and Zeeshan Ali takes the catch to end Janith Liyanage's brilliant 52-run knock.
48.4: V Viyaskanth does not score off Aizaz Khan.
48.5: Aizaz Khan hits the target with ruthless precision, sending V Viyaskanth packing for a duck as the timber crashes to the turf.
Aizaz Khan strikes again, grabbing his second wicket of the over and his third overall to dismantle SLA!
